protocol.purpose: Refine native sampling without changing physical/task parameters or scoring.
protocol.reference: v0.62.0 original 7.5/6 mm tofu and 6/5 mm banana cohorts retain their identities.
protocol.acceptance: Unchanged independent scorer. Full and half-step pass all checks; uncut/partial keep 1/2 tofu components and valid numerical records. No parameter correction after results.
protocol.provenance: Independent synthetic CPU profile, not the authors configuration. Banana remains synthetic elastic; the paper banana parameter/model gap is audited separately.
protocol.metric_sampling: Physical saved times, no animation-created motion. Affine paired-face opening and native interior-tetrahedra volume are explicitly defined independent estimators.

manifest.implementation: independent CPU TLMPM reference, synthetic parameters

score.evidence_scope: synthetic CPU reference task; not measured food or authors implementation

metric_definitions.face_opening_mm: Mean signed x distance between affine images of the same reference face; only opposing nonzero native digits for that cut are included. Null means no eligible pairs.
metric_definitions.interior_volume_change_percent: 100 * (current signed tetrahedral volume / reference volume - 1); six tetrahedra per complete interior lattice cell, excluding cells crossing planned cut planes. Middle third for two-cut tofu, all sampled piece interiors otherwise. Inverted tets are counted, never hidden with abs().
metric_definitions.centroid_x_from_start_mm: Equal-mass native particle centroids of fixed reference regions, ordered left to right; displacement from reference positions.
metric_definitions.centroid_x_from_probe_mm: Same centroids relative to the exact saved pre-probe frame; null before the probe.
metric_definitions.knife_material_force_n: Norm of recorded material reaction on the knife at the preceding completed substep; excludes guide, drive and board forces.
metric_definitions.comparison_scope: Native DexLab measurements; original authors sampling and full configuration are unavailable, so these are not same-condition cross-method scores.
